author: Jing-Hu Yang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jwycpfw

steps.title: Prepare Material Mixture Specimens
steps.instruction: Create standard specimens using different proportions of materials.

steps.title: Test Specimen Strength
steps.instruction: Perform strength testing on the prepared standard specimens.

steps.title: Prepare Simulation Models
steps.instruction: Set up the simulation models by creating slots on the right side and installing hydraulic support in the coal seam.

substeps.instruction: Set slots on the right side of the models
Set the hydraulic support in the coal seam

steps.title: Apply Load and Excavate
steps.instruction: Apply a load to the top of the model and perform excavation from the right side.

substeps.instruction: Set load on the top of the model
Excavate from the right of the model in increments of 10cm

steps.title: Monitor Caving Process
steps.instruction: Observe and record data regarding rock breakage and the stress of the hydraulic support during the caving process.
